Desc.SourceString: 初次遇到你的那天，开始转动的星尘。
Desc.LocalizedString: That day we first met, the stardust began to turn.

Desc.LocalizedString: Honey pancakes, almond puffs, lychee cream puffs...Zzz...Zzz...

Desc.SourceString: 我从无数的冰山间穿过，只为带你寻找春天。
Desc.LocalizedString: I braved countless icebergs, just to search for spring with you.

Desc.SourceString: 你听见了吗？这一段旋律是我心底的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you hear that? It's the voice of my heart.

Desc.SourceString: 就算没有你给我讲睡前故事，我等会也是能睡着的。不过……还是多谢你啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if you don't tell me a bedtime story, I'm sure I'll still fall asleep. But... thank you anyway!

Desc.SourceString: 一个人的林间，只能听见竹叶簌簌落下的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alone in the forest, one can only hear the sound of falling bamboo leaves.

Desc.SourceString: 闭上眼睛的那一瞬间，我的脑海中浮现了世间万象。
Desc.LocalizedString: The moment I closed my eyes, the world became clear.

Desc.SourceString: 如果我邀请你一起打游戏，你是不会拒绝我的吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: You'll play with me, won't you?

Desc.SourceString: 天气好的时候，最适合在户外写生了，你可以捕捉到风中的灵感吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: On a nice day, it's perfect for outdoor sketching. Can you capture the inspiration in the breeze?

Desc.SourceString: 我乘风破浪的速度，无人能敌。
Desc.LocalizedString: My speed through the waves is unmatched.

Desc.SourceString: 有时候它们也挺调皮的，居然会一直围着我绕圈，还好我一点都不觉得晕。
Desc.LocalizedString: When they're feeling naughty, they constantly circle around me. Luckily enough, I don't get dizzy at all.

Desc.SourceString: 月夜下盛开的花朵，带着回忆的泪滴。
Desc.LocalizedString: The flowers bloom under the moonlit night, with tears of remembrance.

Desc.SourceString: 被发现了吗？我的业余爱好确实是看侦探小说。
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you find out? Well, I do enjoy reading detective stories.

Desc.SourceString: 我不讨厌下雨的天气，因为它和我很相似。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't mind rainy weather. We suit each other quite well.

Desc.SourceString: 过来吧！和我一起感受速度与激情！
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on! Feel the speed and thrill with me!

Desc.SourceString: 害怕失去的我，只能紧握住手中的气球。
Desc.LocalizedString: Afraid of losing, all I can do is hold the balloon tightly.

Desc.SourceString:
给你介绍一下，这是我最好的朋友——菲，
是菲的出现，让我不再觉得孤独。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Let me introduce you two - this is my best friend, Fay.
Without Fay, I would still be lonely.

Desc.SourceString: 其实我有点好奇，你会为我的新歌打榜吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Will you help my new song climb the charts?

Desc.SourceString: 据说在卡丘世界唱片销售量超过1000万份才能被称为钻石唱片。
Desc.LocalizedString: In Strinova, a record is only certified as “Diamond” if it reaches 10 million sales.

Desc.SourceString: 这幅抽象的作品反映了人类对于巴布洛晶体的初印象。
Desc.LocalizedString: This abstract work reflects humanity's first impression of Bablo Crystals.

Desc.SourceString: 如果发生了这种故障，你就别挣扎了。
Desc.LocalizedString: If this error occurs, just give up.

Desc.SourceString: 这下子安静多了，我反倒能感受到艺术气息了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's much quieter now. I can actually feel the inspiration in the air.

Desc.SourceString: 枪响之后，你能看到什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What will you see after the sound of the gunshot?

Desc.SourceString: 时刻警觉，有所准备，便不会失败。
Desc.LocalizedString: Remain alert and prepared, and you will never fail.

Desc.SourceString: 未知的边界在缩小，已知的世界将无限扩大。
Desc.LocalizedString: As the boundaries of the unknown shrink, the known universe infinitely expands.

Desc.SourceString: 小心一点，别让自己陷入这种困境。
Desc.LocalizedString: If only you were more careful.

Desc.SourceString: 靠近它的一切事物，都会在顷刻间被吞噬。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing escapes its hunger.

Desc.SourceString: 静谧之下，波涛暗涌，人类的命运尚未可知。
Desc.LocalizedString: Beneath the calm lies a hidden storm; humanity's fate remains unknown.

Desc.SourceString: 真不愧是我啊，吃块披萨也能联想到光的折射。
Desc.LocalizedString: Who else but me could munch on pizza and think about light refraction.

Desc.SourceString: 要记住哦，你是被我回收了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I was the one who recycled you. Don't forget it!

Desc.SourceString: 希望你在这里可以找到最简单的快乐。
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope you can find simple happiness here.

Desc.SourceString: 我可什么都没做，只是想请你吃小熊软糖而已。
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't do anything. I just wanted to invite you to have some gummy bears.

Desc.SourceString: 用花来代替子弹，是浪漫主义的行为。
Desc.LocalizedString: Flowers instead of bullets... the dream of a romantic.

Desc.SourceString: 对面的敌人让我有点压力山大。
Desc.LocalizedString: The enemy's giving me major pear-pressure!

Desc.SourceString: 子弹的射速测试正式开始！
Desc.LocalizedString: Time to test out the bullet speed!

Desc.SourceString: 来到卡丘世界，请务必牢记弦理论。
Desc.LocalizedString: When in Strinova, never forget your string theory.

Desc.SourceString: 认真工作的机器人最可爱了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bots that work hard are the cutest.

Desc.SourceString: 你把我伤得那么重，贴个创可贴就算完事了？
Desc.LocalizedString: You hit me so hard! Do you really think a bandage will cut it?

Desc.SourceString: 来88区最好吃的拉面店吃上一碗拉面吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Come and have a bowl of ramen at the best store in Area 88.

Desc.SourceString: 注意这只冰棍，别让它化了！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful with this popsicle. Don't let it melt!!

Desc.SourceString: 沙包大的拳头见过没！？
Desc.LocalizedString: Have you seen a fist as big as a sandbag?

Desc.SourceString: 菜也是一种快乐的态度。
Desc.LocalizedString: Veggies are good for the mood.

Desc.SourceString: 好厚的血啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Not my fault, they're built like a tank!

Desc.SourceString: 当你什么也想不出来的时候，还不如放松一下。
Desc.LocalizedString: When you can't think of anything, you might as well take it easy.

Desc.SourceString: 偶尔抬头看，你会发现很多平时没有留意的细节。
Desc.LocalizedString: Look up every now and then. You might just see the details that others miss.

Desc.SourceString: 不想长大的孩子，就一直保持爱玩的天性吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Want to feel forever young? Keep your playful spirit alive!

Desc.SourceString: 我宣布，人类已经被猫咪征服了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I declare that cats now rule the world.

Desc.SourceString: 竞技比赛哪有不在乎排名的，我非得争第一不可。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's no competition where rankings don't matter. I've got to be number one!

Desc.SourceString: 飘飞时，我几乎感觉不到自己的重量。
Desc.LocalizedString: When gliding, I can barely feel the weight of my own body.

Desc.SourceString: 杯具装红茶，你就歇息吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: The cup's filled with tea. Just relax!

Desc.SourceString: 太阳伞与防晒霜是女孩子对抗夏日的武器。
Desc.LocalizedString: Umbrellas and sunscreen are every girl's secret weapon in the summer.

Desc.SourceString: 这是梅瑞迪斯的私人物品。
Desc.LocalizedString: Property of Meredith.

Desc.SourceString: 这一爪蕴含的力量你遭得住吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can you withstand the power contained within this claw?

Desc.SourceString: 高手一般都穿着拖鞋上战场。
Desc.LocalizedString: Warriors often hit the battlefield in slippers.

Desc.SourceString: 涂鸦讲究的就是随性！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's all about spontaneity!

Desc.SourceString: 先拆了才能重建啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: You’ve got to tear it down before rebuilding.

Desc.SourceString: 抱歉，我只喝可乐。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sorry, but I only drink coke.

Desc.SourceString: 哪怕是将音乐符号化，它也是如此的美妙。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even as symbols, music remains beautiful.

Desc.SourceString: 这是我对自由的诠释。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is how I interpret freedom.

Desc.SourceString: 我们搭载了GTX690巴布洛核显卡的改进型号，一发就可以摧毁一个航母战斗群。
Desc.LocalizedString: With the GTX690 Bablo core graphics card, we'll be able to destroy an aircraft carrier battle group in a single shot.

Desc.SourceString: 裂解，离析，湮灭。
Desc.LocalizedString: Disintegration, isolation, annihilation.

Desc.SourceString: 这个公式曾改变了旧世界。
Desc.LocalizedString: This formula transformed the old world.

Desc.SourceString: 恕我直言，每一秒都值得你全神贯注。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you ask me, every second is worth your undivided attention.

Desc.SourceString: 我就侧目，不说话~
Desc.LocalizedString: I just look sideways and say nothing.

Desc.SourceString: 哎哟，这个溜啊~
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa, that's slick!

Desc.SourceString: 电子竞技还是需要视力的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even esports requires good eyesight.

Desc.SourceString: 下一个是谁？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who's next?

Desc.SourceString: 本无一物，何处透光？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where's the light coming from?

Desc.SourceString: 你说的对，我是来玩刀的。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're right. I'm here to play with knives.

Desc.SourceString: 颜料与冰的对撞，构成了一幅美妙的图画，而你深陷其中。
Desc.LocalizedString: The blend of paint and ice forms a masterpiece that pulls you into its depths.

Desc.SourceString: 火力大喵的强悍程度，你不想领教一下吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Want a taste of Mighty Meow's power?

Desc.SourceString: 音符也疯狂，连夜出逃了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The notes have gone mad. They're running away!

Desc.SourceString: 任何人被打爆之后的心情只剩下了两个字，毁灭！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's only one word that comes to mind in defeat - destruction!

Desc.SourceString: 只有在枪响之后，才会知道谁是小丑。
Desc.LocalizedString: Guess who's the Joker?

Desc.SourceString: 我真的会谢谢你，下次可别这样了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, but let's not do that again.

Desc.SourceString: 疯狂星期四，来捞点薯条吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's Crazy Thursday. Let's get some fries!

Desc.SourceString: 一只南瓜加上另外一只南瓜，只会让生活难上加难。
Desc.LocalizedString: Two pumpkins? What a sticky situation.

Desc.SourceString: 这种程度的恶作剧，完全吓不到我。
Desc.LocalizedString: These kinds of pranks don't faze me at all.

Desc.SourceString: 别想抵赖，我的两只耳朵都听见了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't play dumb. I heard it with my own two ears.

Desc.SourceString: 转发这只有钳的螃蟹，你暴富的日子很快就要来临了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Repost this crab and riches are sure to fall into your lap.

Desc.SourceString: 看到了吗？这只香蕉是在提醒你不要焦虑。
Desc.LocalizedString: See this? The banana is reminding you not to worry.

Desc.LocalizedString: This heartbroken little birdy needs your care.

Desc.SourceString: 你已经是一个成熟的画笔了，你应该学会自己画画。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're already a skilled artist. Time to paint on your own.

Desc.LocalizedString: When you see a butterfly, that means I've come to pay a visit.

Desc.SourceString: 别紧张，我只是想……好好看看你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't be nervous. I just wanted to... get a good look at you.

Desc.SourceString: EVNIA向前冲！打“卡”异次元，各有各的YOUNG！
Desc.LocalizedString: Charge ahead! Explore new dimensions, each with its own youthful spirit!

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎你来认识新的世界。
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to a new world.

Desc.SourceString: 真的不来一杯吗？超好喝的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you sure you don't want any? It's so good!

Desc.LocalizedString: Just let me sleep a little longer...

Desc.LocalizedString: All is quiet without the Internet!

Desc.LocalizedString: I really wish to become rich someday.

Desc.LocalizedString: Watch out for this fierce croc—it might bite or smack you!

Desc.LocalizedString: If you fall down, just take a nap right there.

Desc.LocalizedString: I'll have to try my hardest to survive the battle.

Desc.LocalizedString: A small gesture of my goodwill.

Desc.LocalizedString: The pigeon coos.

Desc.LocalizedString: The exotic scent of flowers feels like a gentle embrace, melting into the air and whisking me away to a rain-kissed manor to watch you dance.

Desc.LocalizedString: Jazz embodies the soul.

Desc.SourceString: 但也不是瞎吹的。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's not just words.

Desc.SourceString: 轻松享受音乐的乐趣。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bask in the joy of music.

Desc.SourceString: 拉薇，这次换我做你的影子。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll be your shadow this time, Lawine.

Desc.SourceString: 这一次，香奈美有没有抓住你的心呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you mesmerized by my performance?

Desc.SourceString: 由我扮演的怪盗黑猫是不是更加酷炫了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Isn't my portrayal of Phantom Black Cat even cooler?

Desc.SourceString: 客人，您点的格罗夫招牌牛排，可以出锅了！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Grove signature steak you ordered is ready to be served!

Desc.SourceString: 瞧一瞧，看一看咯~这可是心夏本人第一推荐的夏日美味！
Desc.LocalizedString: Check it out! It's Kokona's top summer treat recommendation!

Desc.SourceString: 不要着急哦，客人，美味是需要时间的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Patience, please. Delicacies take time.

Desc.SourceString: “良药苦口，乖乖把药吃掉，就能康复了哦。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Bitter medicine works miracles; be brave and take it for a quick recovery."

Desc.SourceString: “正义的假面护士，击败所有的病痛！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The masked nurse of justice, ready to defeat all ailments!"

Desc.SourceString: “希望它能让你的身体，重新充满力量……”
Desc.LocalizedString: "May it restore your body's strength once more..."

Desc.SourceString: 你被风暴席卷的时候，大概不会记得三个月前那只扇动翅膀的蝴蝶吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: When the storm sweeps you away, you probably won't remember the butterfly flapping its wings all those months ago.

Desc.SourceString: 你说说看，这像画吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Well? You tell me—does this look like a painting to you?

Desc.SourceString:
庆祝的时候，记得开香槟！
对了，可不是半场开香槟。
Desc.LocalizedString:
When celebrating, don't forget to pop the champagne!
Just don't do it at halftime.

Desc.SourceString: 我将默默承受一切。
Desc.LocalizedString: I shall bear it all in silence.

Desc.SourceString: 我会亲手制裁你。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll punish you myself.

Desc.SourceString: 机器人不得伤害人类，或坐视人类受到伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: A robot must not harm humans or let harm come to them.

Desc.SourceString: 这告示上的人好像有点眼熟啊……等等，这不是我吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: The person on this bounty looks familiar... Wait, isn't this me?

Desc.SourceString: 与世界问好后，代码构筑了一切。
Desc.LocalizedString: After greeting the world, the code created everything.

Desc.SourceString: 都什么时候了，你在还在找安全出口？
Desc.LocalizedString: What time is it? Are you still looking for a safe exit?

Desc.SourceString:
在数据的世界里，死亡不过是一串代码的终结。
那墓碑的意义何在？
Desc.LocalizedString:
In a world of data, death is just the end of a string of code.
So, what's the purpose of a tombstone?

Desc.SourceString: 分析、布阵、战斗——勇气和智慧必将带来胜利的终局。
Desc.LocalizedString: If thought itself is just matter, how can we prove that we are conscious at all?

Desc.SourceString: 那座塔将伫立至永远。有人说那是信标，也有人说那是桎梏。
Desc.LocalizedString: This tower will stand for eternity. Some call it a beacon. Others, a shackle.

Desc.SourceString: 核心科技永不落后。
Desc.LocalizedString: Core technology never falls behind.

Desc.SourceString:
“A点A点，安包安包！”
“等等，我炸弹呢？”
Desc.LocalizedString:
"A site secure! Plant the bomb!"

"Wait... where's my bomb?"

Desc.SourceString: 抢修中，请勿靠近！
Desc.LocalizedString: Repairs in progress. Do not enter!

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎光临。请问您今天要来点什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome. What would you like today?

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎您的到来~喜欢香奈美的特别装扮吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome! Do you like Kanami's special outfit?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯，欢迎您……那个，一直盯着看，很不好意思啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ehm. Welcome... It's, uhm, awkward if you keep staring...

Desc.SourceString: 就这么擦掉也有点可惜……再闻一会吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a pity to just wipe it off... Let's keep the aroma around for a bit.

Desc.SourceString: 淡雅甘美，沁入心脾。
Desc.LocalizedString: Elegant, sweet, and oh-so-refreshing.

Desc.SourceString: 坚果酥脆，唇齿留香。
Desc.LocalizedString: The nuts are crispy and leave a fragrant taste in your mouth.

Desc.SourceString: 丝丝香甜，月圆蜜意。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sweet and homely, like the moonlight.

Desc.SourceString: 丰润鲜香，回味深长。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rich and savory, with an enduring aftertaste.

Desc.SourceString: 三点几啦，饮茶先啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's three o'clock! Time for tea!

Desc.SourceString: 科学是一条微妙的探索之路……
Desc.LocalizedString: Science is a subtle road to discovery...

Desc.SourceString: 心夏办事儿你放心~
Desc.LocalizedString: Worry not. Kokona's on the case!

Desc.SourceString: 我们共享一轮圆月。
Desc.LocalizedString: We share a full moon.

Desc.SourceString: 梦想总会在星空中发光。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dreams always shine in the starry sky.

Desc.SourceString: 听了我的歌声，就要乖乖缴械投降哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: After hearing me sing, you better be good and surrender.

Desc.SourceString: 左左右右，一起跟着音乐来跳喵喵舞吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Left, left, right! Let's do the meow dance together!

Desc.SourceString: 啊？这歌声控制了我的行动。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah? The song's got control of my body.

Desc.SourceString: 我和菲……什么时候学会跳应援舞了呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Fay and I... when did we learn how to dance?

Desc.SourceString: 你是一个成熟的键盘，应该学会自己打游戏了。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're already experienced with the keyboard. It's time to learn how to game.

Desc.SourceString: 自信，沉稳，谦让，精准，睿智。
Desc.LocalizedString: Confident, calm, humble, precise, and wise.

Desc.SourceString: 别以为我是被人挂起来了，我只是偶尔想要晒晒太阳。
Desc.LocalizedString: No one hung me up here. I just wanted to bask in the sun.

Desc.SourceString: 原来你也玩颜料罐，和我一起启动吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: You like to spray paint too? Let's work together!

Desc.SourceString: 守望之眼用得好，欢乐自然少不了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Master the Guardian Eye for endless thrills.

Desc.SourceString: 小心每一个窗口，火力大喵随时都可能出现。
Desc.LocalizedString: Beware of every window, as Mighty Meow could pop out at any time.

Desc.SourceString: 糟糕，我被抓住了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no! I've been hooked.

Desc.SourceString: 在我真正放弃之前，绝不会输。
Desc.LocalizedString: As long as I don't give up, I will not lose.

Desc.SourceString: 平安苹安，同话童话。
Desc.LocalizedString: All is well in the fairy tale.

Desc.SourceString: 呼呼呼——创造艺术，还是要用大胆一点的配色呢……唔……你怎么也被我画进梦里了……欸嘿，让我给你添上两笔……
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew! Art must be created with bold colors... Hmm... How did you end up in my dream painting? He-he, let me add a few more touches...

Desc.SourceString: 你已经很努力啦，偶尔停下来享受悠闲的时光，也很好哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: You've been working hard. Why don't you take a break once in a while?

Desc.SourceString: 不好意思，我正在重启系统。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sorry, I'm rebooting the system.

Desc.SourceString: 为什么宠物总是对卫生纸情有独钟呢?
Desc.LocalizedString: Why are pets so obsessed with tissues?

Desc.SourceString: 准备好了吗？我现在要随机摇人了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you ready? I'm about to summon my friends.

Desc.SourceString: 大火烤串，小心焦了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful! Don't burn the kebab!

Desc.SourceString: 又到了火力旺盛的季节了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The season of energy has returned.

Desc.SourceString: 我已经连夜逃出地球了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've escaped from Earth overnight.

Desc.SourceString: 一把好的水枪能让你在打水仗中获胜。
Desc.LocalizedString: A top-notch water gun can turn the tide in any splash battle!

Desc.SourceString: 尝尝这把枪的滋味吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taste my gun!

Desc.SourceString: 多一点气泡，多一点快乐。
Desc.LocalizedString: More bubbles, more happiness.

Desc.SourceString: 面对噪音污染，我已经堵住耳朵了！
Desc.LocalizedString: How to deal with noise pollution? Just cover your ears!

Desc.SourceString: 嘘！香奈美发现了一个宝物，如果你替我保密的话，我就偷偷给你看哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Shh! I've found a treasure. If you can keep a secret, I'll show it to you.

Desc.SourceString: “唔……太阳升起来了，所以呢？我要继续睡了。”
Desc.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Desc.SourceString: 身体的劳累，就让菲来治愈吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Desc.SourceString: 一起将溜冰场填补完满吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's fill the ice rink!

Desc.SourceString: 看来太过高效的雇佣兵，也会成为别人的眼中钉……
Desc.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Desc.SourceString: 卡丘人，集结！
Desc.LocalizedString: Strinovians, assemble!

Desc.SourceString: 上半场我赢，下半场还是我赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: I won the first half. I'll win the second half, too!

Desc.SourceString: 我们交错，旋转，接合，只为寻找世界真实的颜色。
Desc.LocalizedString: We twist, turn, and connect, seeking the world's true colors.

Desc.SourceString: 感受一下吧，我精心调制的完美香味。
Desc.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Desc.SourceString: 你知道的，我们也曾采用作画记事。
Desc.LocalizedString: Believe it or not, we've used art for record-keeping too.

Desc.SourceString: 菲说，我们必须看起来更有威严……
Desc.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Desc.SourceString: 投掷后随机出现“A”或“B”骰子，那么“C”点怎么办？
Desc.LocalizedString: Roll the dice for either "A" or "B"—but what about point "C"?

Desc.SourceString: 在与明战斗后，某人留下了这个警示牌。
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone left this warning sign after fighting with Ming.

Desc.SourceString: 在与梅瑞迪斯战斗后，某人留下了这个警示牌。
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone left this warning sign after fighting with Meredith.

Desc.SourceString: 在与伊薇特战斗后，某人留下了这个警示牌。
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone left this warning sign after fighting with Yvette.

Desc.SourceString: 招财进宝，日进斗晶！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wish for wealth and prosperity every day!

Desc.SourceString: 在与艾卡战斗后，某人留下了这个警示牌。
Desc.LocalizedString: A warning sign left by someone after battling Eika.

Desc.SourceString: 环顾四周，队友怎么多了一个……画里的人跑出来了？
Desc.LocalizedString: There's an extra teammate... Did someone from the painting come out?

Desc.SourceString: 在与绯莎战斗后，某人留下了这个警示牌。
Desc.LocalizedString: This caution sign was placed after a fight with Fuchsia.

Desc.SourceString: 就连剪刀手的研究员都对它丰富的功能性感到惊叹！
Desc.LocalizedString: Its impressive functionality astonishes even the researchers at The Scissors!

Desc.SourceString: “游戏，引领世界前行！”
Desc.LocalizedString: Games lead the way!

Desc.SourceString: 我心碎了喵！把分还给我喵！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm heartbroken, meow! Return my points, meow!

Desc.SourceString: 真怀念过去一起玩闹的时光啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: I really miss the times we played together.

Desc.SourceString: 别炸我了！放我出去！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop bombing me! Let me out!

Desc.SourceString: 这个可比移动靶好打多了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Way easier to hit than a moving target.

Desc.SourceString: 这是谁的分？再不管可要吊了哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whose points are these? Better claim them before they drop!

Desc.SourceString: 大胆前压，小心观察！
Desc.LocalizedString: Advance boldly, observe carefully!

Desc.SourceString: 我们的工程已经全部通过剪刀手质量认证。
Desc.LocalizedString: Our projects have full quality certification from The Scissors.

Desc.SourceString: 棋逢对手，将遇良才，不如等会儿一起开摆？
Desc.LocalizedString: A worthy opponent—shall we start the match together later?

Desc.SourceString: 薯条们！听我号令，向他们反击！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fries! Follow my lead, let's strike back!

Desc.SourceString: 注意，你的敌人非常蕉滑。
Desc.LocalizedString: Beware, your enemy is very slippery.

Desc.SourceString: 我才到这，你怎么就到那儿了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I just showed up, how are you so far ahead?

Desc.SourceString: 市民请注意，前方闹市区，禁止大声喧哗。
Desc.LocalizedString: Notice: Urban zone ahead. Please stay quiet.

Desc.SourceString: 建设卡丘世界，我辈义不容辞！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's our responsibility to build Strinova!

Desc.SourceString: 上上下下左右左右……什么？空了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right… What? I missed?

Desc.SourceString: 微风吹拂，裙摆飘扬，是青春最美的模样。试着给超弦体伙伴穿上，会有奇妙的事情发生哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: The hem sways in the gentle breeze, capturing the beauty of youth. Try putting it on your Superstring partner for something magical to happen!

Desc.SourceString:
来自宇宙空间的讯号，与卡丘世界碰撞出热烈的火花。靠近它，便能找到化身异星来客的方法。
【卡拉彼丘XAlienware 联动活动限定喷漆】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A cosmic signal sparks with Strinova. Get close to it on the wall, and something interesting may happen.

[Exclusive Spray from the Strinova X Alienware Event]

Desc.SourceString:
是涂鸦墙上的神秘图案，也是宇宙投下的匆匆一瞥。
【卡拉彼丘XAlienware 联动活动限定喷漆】
Desc.LocalizedString:
A cosmic glimpse captured in a graffiti pattern.

[Exclusive Spray from the Strinova X Alienware Event]

Desc.SourceString: 愿弦能之力与你同在。
Desc.LocalizedString: May the power of the strings be with you.

Desc.SourceString: 你的灵魂已被标记。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your soul has been marked.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗如此频繁，我甚至都不能安静地把水喝完。
Desc.LocalizedString: The battles are endless; I can't even finish a drink in peace.

Desc.SourceString: 天赋选手也需要不断进步。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even the gifted must keep improving.

Desc.SourceString: 为了胜利，米雪儿会负重前行
Desc.LocalizedString: For victory's sake, Michele will endure.

Desc.SourceString: 让我看看是哪个家伙会闯进我的视线。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's see who dares to enter my sight.

Desc.SourceString: 请注意，这是你要求我爆炒的菜。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please note: this is the dish you asked me to stir-fry—extra hot.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗的闲暇，补充一下水分和阳光吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Take a break from battle to replenish with water and sunlight.

Desc.SourceString: 相信我，伙伴，我已经在路上了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Trust me, buddy. I'm already on my way… promise.

Desc.SourceString: 思考的结果，有可能是发现，也有可能是发笑。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your thoughts might spark a discovery or a good laugh.

Desc.SourceString: 到了这种时刻，最重要是好好回收弦序列。
Desc.LocalizedString: At times like these, retrieving string sequences is key.

Desc.SourceString: 前方发生交战，请市民在远处观战。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stay back and observe from afar; conflict is underway.

Desc.SourceString: 这是数据损坏的余象，也是意识崩溃的残响。
Desc.LocalizedString: A trace of corrupted data and shattered consciousness.

Desc.SourceString: 共同的危机会让我们重新凝聚。
Desc.LocalizedString: Shared threats bring us together again.

Desc.SourceString: 花香的弥漫，是温室里的生命在盛大逃亡。
Desc.LocalizedString: As floral scents fill the air, life within the greenhouse begins its magnificent escape.

Desc.SourceString: 年轻画家的笔触，将梦境凝固在绘制的瞬间。
Desc.LocalizedString: A young artist's brush captures dreams in timeless strokes.

Desc.SourceString: 一个存在于历史和绘卷中的美丽景致。
Desc.LocalizedString: A breathtaking sight woven into history and art.

Desc.SourceString: 灵魂升温的最佳燃料。
Desc.LocalizedString: The perfect fuel to warm your soul.

Desc.SourceString: 扳手在任何情况下都很可靠。
Desc.LocalizedString: A wrench is reliable, no matter the circumstance.

Desc.SourceString: 满血就是我的斩杀线。
Desc.LocalizedString: Full health won't save you from me.

Desc.SourceString: 请打开麦克风交流。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please turn on your mic to chat.

Desc.SourceString: 高效无痛，一命通关。
Desc.LocalizedString: Fast and painless.

Desc.SourceString: 就让它飞一会儿，没规定必须命中吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let it soar, there's no rule it has to hit.

Name.LocalizedString: Damn it... I should not have lost!

Desc.SourceString: 参赛作品的第一名。引航者@pewchii_的绝妙之作。
Desc.LocalizedString: First place winner: A brilliant creation by Navigator@pewchii_.

Desc.SourceString: 真玩家，从不回头看爆炸。
Desc.LocalizedString: Real players never look back.

Desc.SourceString: 恭喜你在弦区争夺中获得了：一百分！
Desc.LocalizedString: Congratulations! You've scored a perfect 100 points in Conquest!

Desc.SourceString: “世界这么大，我的梦会找到最有趣的解答。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The world is vast, my dreams will find the most intriguing answers."

Desc.SourceString: “现在是，愉快的奇想时间！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "It's time for delightful wonders!"

Desc.SourceString: “大喵快跑，我们这次也要拿到第一名！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Go, Mighty Meow, we’re taking the top spot!"

Desc.SourceString: “哼，这一拳，二十天的功力，你挡得住吗！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hmph, this punch has 20 days of power. Can you handle it?"

Desc.SourceString: “保持优质睡眠也是优秀射手应该养成的习惯。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Quality sleep is essential for any skilled archer."

Desc.SourceString: “我是千代，请多多关照。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'm Chiyo. Pleased to meet you."

Desc.SourceString: “你能打中的！你能打中的吧？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "You can make the shot, can't you?"

Desc.SourceString: “多加海盐，少加芝士，更健康，更活力！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "With extra sea salt and less cheese, it's healthier and more energizing!"

Desc.SourceString: “世界并非正反，而是分为真幻。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The world divides into reality and illusion, not right and wrong."

Desc.SourceString: “希望我们都能健健康康，成长为自己想要成为的模样。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hope we all grow strong into our best selves."

Desc.SourceString: “任何时间，任何地点，萌萌豆子，准备战斗！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Any time, any place, sweet beans are ready to fight!"

Desc.SourceString: “骂我，我装没听到，打我，我就叫。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Insult away, I don't care, but hit me, and I'll quack."

Desc.SourceString: “祝福的心意并不会随文明的迁徙而改变。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The intent to bless remains constant, unchanged by the tides of civilization."

Desc.SourceString: “技术扎实，心态沉稳，就能在任何地方冲浪。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Surf anywhere with solid technique and a steady mind."

Desc.SourceString: “抓不到没关系，时间到了它会自己出来找你。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Can't catch it? No worries, it’ll come to you in time."

Desc.SourceString: “请各位超弦体文明交流。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Please remain civilized."

Desc.SourceString: “下一秒，我按下的手指就会改变未来！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "One press, and I'll change the future!"

Desc.SourceString: “出厂协议里没有这条规则！我要向机器人保护协会投诉！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "That's not in the factory protocol! I'm reporting this to the Robot Protection League!"

Desc.SourceString: “我我我真的这么有吸引力？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Am I really that attractive?"

Desc.SourceString: “我没有生气，我只是非常谢谢你的打气！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I’m not mad; I'm just super grateful for your support!"

Desc.SourceString: “弦能炸弹怎么还没引爆？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Is the bomb still ticking?"

Desc.SourceString: “天灵灵，地灵灵，下局活到最后行不行？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Heaven and earth, will I survive the next round?"

Desc.SourceString: “下一次战争，我们将会用上好玩的武器。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "We'll use exciting weapons in the next war."

Desc.SourceString: “三种标记，三种选择，三种结局？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Three markers, three choices, three outcomes?"

Desc.SourceString: “这一箭，可断金石，诛邪恶，守公义。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "This arrow pierces steel, vanquishes evil, and upholds justice."

Desc.SourceString: “下一位登场的明星是谁呢？请喊出她的名字！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Who will grace the stage next? Cheer her name!"

Desc.SourceString: “来挑战一下吧！你能击中这个靶心吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Give it a shot! Can you hit the bullseye?"

Desc.SourceString: “目前飞机受气流影响会有一点颠簸，请系好安全带哦。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "We're experiencing some turbulence. Please fasten your seatbelt."

Desc.SourceString: “我一定可以练就高超的飞行驾驶技术！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'll definitely become an expert in flight control!"

Desc.SourceString: “气球带走了伊薇特！她越飞越远了……”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Yvette's been taken by the balloon! She's drifting away..."

Desc.SourceString: “在孩童手中，它是折叠梦想的纸飞机。在英雄肩上，它是迎风招展的披风。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "To a child, it's a dream-folding paper plane. To a hero, it's a cape waving in the breeze."

Desc.SourceString: “听着这张唱片，我仿佛坐上了神秘的宇宙飞船，穿越着浩瀚的星际。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Listening to this record feels like boarding a mysterious spaceship, journeying across the galaxy."

Desc.SourceString: “在赛场上发挥出色，为队伍带来好成绩的成员就是你！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "It's you who excels and drives the team to victory!"

Desc.SourceString: 救灾无人机肩负着独特的科技使命——把携带弦序列的盒子运回总部。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rescue drones have a unique mission: return boxes with Strinova sequences to HQ.

Desc.SourceString: 希望这个图标出现在敌方的队伍，而非我方的队伍。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's hope this icon is for their team, not ours.

Desc.SourceString: 这是一场精心策划、只为特定对象所准备的盛大惊喜。
Desc.LocalizedString: A grand surprise, crafted just for that special someone.

Desc.SourceString: 首起涉及外星飞船盗取晶核的案件，至今仍未侦破。
Desc.LocalizedString: The first alien ship crystal heist remains unsolved.

Desc.SourceString: 每一次火箭的腾跃，都是人类对未知世界的勇敢探索。
Desc.LocalizedString: Each rocket launch is humanity's brave exploration of the unknown.

Desc.SourceString: 这个世界究竟是像发条装置还是掷骰子的桌子呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the world a mechanism or a roll of the dice?

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺商业联盟为VIP客户准备的赠礼，小巧但价值不菲。
Desc.LocalizedString: A gift prepared by the Urbino Business Alliance for VIP clients, small but invaluable.

Desc.SourceString: 你哈气了，我宣布，你就是真正的哈基米！
Desc.LocalizedString: You fogged it up! I hereby crown you the one true Hajimi!

Desc.SourceString: 危险总是不期而至，小心背后！
Desc.LocalizedString: Danger comes unexpectedly, so be cautious!

Desc.SourceString: 这个世界好危险，躲进壳里最安全。
Desc.LocalizedString: This world is dangerous, so seeking shelter inside is the safest choice.

Desc.SourceString: 大力摇晃白墨一次，即可获得金币一枚。
Desc.LocalizedString: Shake Bai Mo vigorously to earn a coin.

Desc.SourceString: 来咯，就地试吃！别着急，下一口就会喂给你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Here comes the tasting! Don't worry, the next bite is for you!

Desc.SourceString: 我亲手做了些糕点，外皮酥脆，内馅软糯，请你务必尝一尝。
Desc.LocalizedString: I made some pastries with crispy exteriors and soft fillings. Please try them.

Desc.SourceString: 瞧好了，哪怕本大喵只使用左右直拳，也能打赢对手！
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch closely, even with just left and right jabs, I can beat the opponent!

Desc.SourceString: 加油哦！香奈美会在这里，把所有的力量都通过呐喊传递给你们！
Desc.LocalizedString: Go for it! Kanami will be here, cheering with all her might for you!

Desc.SourceString: 你的创作让卡丘世界异彩纷呈！让我们继续描绘美好吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Your creations bring vibrance to Strinova! Let's keep painting a beautiful world!

Desc.SourceString: “上班是人类最糟糕的发明，今天也是想要毁灭人类的一天。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Work is humanity's worst invention. Another day to consider its end."

Desc.SourceString: “跟我比哈气？你有这个实力吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Think you can out-huff me? Do you have what it takes?"

Desc.SourceString: “看我认真的表情，没有半分虚假”
Desc.LocalizedString: "See my serious face? Not a hint of pretense."

Desc.SourceString: “什么？！听说我上次的计谋成了？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "What?! My plan worked last time?"

Desc.SourceString: “他们说我的笑容有那么一点诡异。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "They say there's something odd about my smile."

Desc.SourceString: “我肚子里有一根蜡烛，头上也有一根，这就叫做内外敞亮。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "With a candle inside and atop, I'm all about glowing inside and out."

Desc.SourceString: “游荡时间到！让我飘来飘去。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The hour to wander has come! drift around."

Desc.SourceString: “坚强，真心，无敌，美丽，精神，勇气，梦想！米雪儿，梦的使者在此登场！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "With strength, heart, invincibility, beauty, spirit, courage, and dreams! Michele, the Messenger of Dreams, is here!"

Desc.SourceString: 追随芙拉薇娅的脚步吧！她将会为你带来好运与财富。
Desc.LocalizedString: Follow Flavia's lead for good fortune and riches.

Desc.SourceString: “这才眨眼的工夫，外面就已经黑漆漆的了！我得赶紧多点几支火把！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "It's suddenly so dark outside! I must quickly light more torches!"

Desc.SourceString: “等会你一定会心甘情愿地臣服于我。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Soon you'll willingly bow to me."

Desc.SourceString: “火力大喵帮我拿来了冰冰凉凉的酸奶冰激凌！你要不要尝一下？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I've got some yogurt ice cream from Mighty Meow! Want a taste?"

Desc.SourceString: 在卡奥斯圣殿战役中，欧泊、剪刀手和乌尔比诺的“三巨头”集聚一堂，打算暴揍晶源体。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the heart of the Sanctuary of Chaos, the formidable trio—P.U.S, The Scissors, and Urbino—join forces to take down the Crystallines with full might.

Desc.SourceString: 在莉莉丝的眼中，飞驰的子弹就像是凝滞在半空之中。她只需要微微侧身，就能轻松躲开。
Desc.LocalizedString: In Lilith's eyes, bullets appear suspended. With a simple sidestep, she deftly avoids them.

Desc.SourceString: 一簇璀璨的烟火点亮了夜幕，在万众齐声的倒数之后，宣告了新一年的到来。
Desc.LocalizedString: A burst of dazzling fireworks lit up the night after the countdown, announcing the start of a brand new year.

Desc.SourceString: ”跨年晚餐准备好了，全都是你们爱吃的菜哦！让我们一起举杯，庆祝新年！“
Desc.LocalizedString: "New Year's feast is ready, filled with all your favorite dishes! Let's raise our glass to celebrate a brand new year!"

Desc.SourceString: “下一局该使用什么战术？我一点头绪都没有！你有什么建议吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "What tactics should we use next round? Any suggestions?"

Desc.SourceString: “让我看看花环上都有什么好东西，饼干玩偶、彩色袜子、铃铛、盲盒……哇，是晶核！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "What's in the wreath? Cookies, bright socks, jingles, surprise boxes... Wow, it's a crystal!"

Desc.SourceString: “桃林深处，春天正在倾尽所有的烂漫，拥抱奔赴而来的你。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "In the heart of the peach forest, spring unfolds every last trace of its beauty, wrapping you in a tender embrace as you arrive."

Desc.SourceString: 在香奈美叩响扳机的一瞬间，超能武器“世宙星声”便将她的意志迸发为万千炽光，如宇宙洪流般轰入战场。
Desc.LocalizedString: As Kanami pulls the trigger, the psionic weapon Voice of the Cosmos unleashes her will in a torrent of searing light, flooding the battlefield.

Desc.SourceString: “呐，来陪我玩个游戏吧，规则很简单！等会我假装开枪，你就应声倒下，怎么样？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hey, want to play a game with me? The rules are simple! I'll pretend to fire, and you drop on cue—got it?"

Desc.SourceString: “我不躲，你最好也别躲！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Stand your ground. If I am taking it head-on, so are you!"

Desc.SourceString: “引航者，红包和寄语我都有收到呢，真的很感谢你。这是我为你准备的回礼，希望能把这份心意传递下去，请……一定要收下。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Navigator, I received both your red packet and your message. Thank you so much! This is my gift in return—please, I hope you'll accept it."

Desc.SourceString: “拿去——要记住哦，这可是我给你发的压岁钱！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Here you go—remember, this is the New Year gift from me!"

Desc.SourceString: “嗯，我准备了很多红包，可以一次性全部发完吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hmm, I've prepared a lot of red packets. Can I send them all at once?"

Desc.SourceString: “要不要和我比一比？看谁今天拿到的红包最多！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Wanna compete with me? Let's see who collects the most red packets today!"

Desc.SourceString: “使不得使不得，这可使不得，我哪好意思呀……欸？你怎么把红包放我口袋了？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "No, no, you can't do that! I couldn't possibly… wait, when did you put the red packet in my pocket?"

Desc.SourceString: “星桥映雪妆春树，银花照夜愿良年。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Star-lit bridges gleam like snow, spring trees dressed in silver light, carrying wishes for a fortunate year ahead."

Desc.SourceString: “中庭阑夜花燃雪，惊回红墙一园春。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Blossoms ignite the night like falling snow, their echoes rousing an entire garden into spring."

Desc.SourceString: “娇儿顾盼观桃符，烧灯笑游寻屠苏。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Lanterns glow, laughter fills the air, and spring celebrations spill across the courtyard."

Desc.SourceString: “猜猜看，在这些小家伙里，谁才是那个最爱捣蛋的淘气包呢？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Take a guess—out of all these little rascals, who's the one causing the most trouble?"

Desc.SourceString: “我可不是在秀操作，我是实打实的强悍！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'm not just showing off; I'm genuinely powerful!"

Desc.SourceString: “星芒咖啡推出新品了，你要不要喝一杯呢？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "This is new on Starlight Coffee's menu, would you give it a try?"

Desc.SourceString: “既然是任务需要，那我就开始演奏吧。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Since this is a mission, I'll begin my performance."

Desc.SourceString: “我来演奏一首怀旧名曲，你们可别听哭了。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'm about to play a nostalgic classic, don't go crying on me now."

Desc.SourceString: “诶？是我变强了吗？这个杠铃轻得像羽毛一样，快给我加重量！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Wait, am I stronger now? This barbell's lighter than a feather—quick, add more weight!"

Desc.SourceString: “这个游戏……真好玩，下次推荐给引航者。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "This game... it's so much fun. I'll definitely recommend it to Navigator next time."

Desc.SourceString: “你喜欢使用什么样的战术道具？是威力大的破片手雷，还是把人带上天的风场雷？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "What's your favorite tactical gear? The mighty Frag Grenades or the Windstorm Grenades that send people flying?"

Desc.SourceString: “有一些美好的瞬间，真的会让人忍不住按下快门。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Some moments are just so beautiful, you can't help but hit the shutter button."

Desc.SourceString: “欧泊和剪刀手的选手都已就位，擂台对决一触即发，你认为谁的赢面更大？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "With P.U.S and The Scissors ready in the opposite corner, the stage is set for an epic showdown. Who do you think has the upper hand?"

Desc.SourceString: “对面的伤害太高了！我的血条怕是撑不住啊！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The enemy's hitting too hard! I don't think my health bar will survive this!"

Desc.SourceString: “没错，最酷的音乐达人就是我！需要我给你推荐几首流行音乐吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "That's right, I'm the ultimate music expert! Want me to recommend some hot tunes?"

Desc.SourceString: “今天这场面，那可真是锣鼓喧天，鞭炮齐鸣，人山人海，热闹非凡啊！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "What a scene today! Drums are beating, firecrackers are blasting, and there's a crowd everywhere—what an absolute spectacle!"

Desc.SourceString: “为所有值得欢庆的小事，也为此刻陪伴在身旁的你们，干杯！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "For every little thing worth celebrating, and for all of you standing here with me right now—cheers!"

Desc.SourceString: “你试过在荡秋千的时候向后仰头吗？世界颠倒的瞬间，会感觉自己跌入了云端呢！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Have you tried leaning back on a swing? As the world turns upside down, it's like diving into the sky!"

Desc.SourceString: “让你见识一下，这把武器得这么用！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Let me show you how to wield this weapon!"

Desc.SourceString: “我正在帮艾卡评估这顶玩偶帽的试戴效果……如果反馈不错，她打算进点货去街头售卖。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'm helping Eika test how this plush hat looks… If the feedback's good, she might start selling them on the street."

Desc.SourceString: “听说摇晃出更多的气泡，会让汽水变得更好喝呢。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "They say the more bubbles you shake up, the better soda tastes!"

Desc.SourceString: “甜品转转杯……快点停下来，不要再转了哇！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "This spinning dessert cup… make it stop, please—no more spinning!"

Desc.SourceString: “这是一块香香甜甜的小蛋糕，你快来尝一尝！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "This is a soft, sweet little cake—come have a taste!"

Desc.SourceString: “恭喜你获得了火力大喵的认可！喵喵喵喵！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Congratulations! You've earned Mighty Meow's approval! Meow meow meow!"

Desc.SourceString: “火力大喵永远支持你！火力大喵永远追随你！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Mighty Meow will always support you! Always cheering you on!"

Desc.SourceString: “每一块巧克力上都印着猫咪的表情，简直太可爱了！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Each piece of chocolate is stamped with a cute kitty face—too adorable!"

Desc.SourceString: “心夏手工捏制的兔兔面包胚、裹满浓郁酱汁的牛排，搭配上鲜嫩的时蔬，共同组成了这个美味的汉堡。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "A bunny-shaped bun handcrafted by Kokona, paired with a juicy steak coated in rich sauce and fresh veggies—coming together in one delicious burger."

Desc.SourceString: “灯火辉映，神鳞闪烁，没想到只是片刻的捞金鱼游戏，也能让我看到如此美好的画面。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Lanterns glow, scales shimmer—who would’ve thought a simple goldfish scooping game could reveal such a beautiful sight?"

Desc.SourceString: “我只吃一个小小的杯子蛋糕，今天的热量摄入总不至于超标吧？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "I'll just have one little cupcake… it shouldn't ruin my calorie count today, right?"

Desc.SourceString: “将黄桃果肉和奶油冰激凌搅拌在一起，可以调和出一种奇妙的风味。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Mixing sweet yellow peach chunks with creamy ice cream creates a wonderfully unique flavor."

Desc.SourceString: “我放到冰箱里的布丁怎么不见了？到底是谁偷吃的啊？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The pudding I left in the fridge is gone… who ate it?!"

Desc.SourceString:
“咦咦咦你不要过来啊！”
“来嘛来嘛，偶像怎么能临阵脱逃呢！”
Desc.LocalizedString:
"H-Hey, don't come any closer!"
"Oh, come on~ How can an idol back out now?"

GainParam2.SourceString: 南国海滨配套活动喷漆

Desc.SourceString: 赤红的油汤从山顶奔涌而下，蒸腾的热气裹着浓香扑面而来，锅里的食材终于熟了！让我们大口吃肉，尝一尝这滚烫人间的烟火滋味。
Desc.LocalizedString: A crimson broth cascades like a torrent, steam rising with a rich, mouthwatering aroma—the ingredients are finally ready! Time to dig in and savor the fiery, vibrant taste of life.

Desc.LocalizedString: Aether is the ultimate matter, extending to the universe's edge. Season 1 ranked reward.
